priv.title: Privacy
priv.p1: This demo website sets no cookies, uses no analytics or advertising trackers, and loads no external fonts, scripts or images.
priv.p2: When you choose a language, only the language code is stored in your browser (localStorage) so the site opens in that language next time. You can delete it in your browser settings.
priv.p3: The appointment form is a demonstration. It checks your input in your browser and sends nothing; no data is stored or transmitted.
priv.p4: Hosting provider, data controller and your GDPR rights must be added before a real launch.
